A '''Nightsister crystal ball''' was a crystal ball owned by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. The crystal ball could predict the future. [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] used it to help [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] locate [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. It was later used by Talzin to help Opress locate [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].
